name: cmdexa
description: Connect ChatGPT to your Windows PC to find files, inspect logs and run PowerShell with required approvals.

interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to a Windows PC you own or are authorized to administer. Search local files in a selected folder, inspect Windows build or application logs, preview a folder-organization plan, or run a requested PowerShell command after the applicable permissions and local approvals. Cmdexa enables Windows automation through your paired computer; it is not a remote desktop or screen-sharing service.

Install the digitally signed Cmdexa Windows application, pair your computer using your Google account, and connect Cmdexa in ChatGPT with the same account. No separate Node.js install is needed. Your Windows PC must be online to run tasks. Each account can access only its own paired devices and data.

Start with Read only access for inspection. For changes, choose Read and run; some actions require explicit confirmation or local Windows approval, while others may be blocked by safety policy. Review a proposed file-move plan before approving changes. You can revoke the computer's connection from your Cmdexa account.

Cmdexa's content is suitable for general audiences, but the current beta is limited to adults acting in a business or professional capacity; consumer use is excluded. ChatGPT plugin availability also depends on plan and workspace. Tool results are sent to your AI provider as described in the privacy policy.
capabilities: Find local Windows files in a folder you choose
Inspect Windows build and application logs
Preview folder organization before approved changes
Run PowerShell commands under device permissions and approvals
defaultPrompt: Find PDF files on my paired Windows PC; read only.
Read my Windows build log and explain its error; do not change files.
Check my paired Windows PC, then run a PowerShell command with required approval.

MCP endpoint, authentication, icons, legal links, beta restriction and review recording are unchanged. No server or Windows agent changes.
